text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I ran so much today... An extra-large bowl 
of rice isn't gonna be enough~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan. If you'd like... would you want 
a bit of mine, too?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I don't really need that much, 
anyway...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Sharing her food with someone else... 
Suzuka-san, could you be... a goddess...!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Spe-chan really does look best when 
she's happily eating.

And so, before she even realized it, 
Silence Suzuka had apparently succeeded in 
her diet.
